main_reasons: Tiny OTC Pink shell-like company (46 holders of record, sporadic trading) with going-concern doubt, no independent directors, no audit committee and admitted material weaknesses including no control over related-party transactions

Equity valuations rest on thin, volatile quotes: 5M shares to the new president and 5M shares to Kilgore each valued at $7.5M ($1.50/share), while shares were sold for cash at $0.50 in the same window; the Kilgore acquisition never closed, the $7.548M was impaired, and Kilgore is now suing for shares

About 48% of FY2025 revenue ($115k of $241k) comes from a company controlled by a related party, and some cost of revenue is also from a related-party subcontractor; the revenue policy is boilerplate copied from the old consulting business

Deposit for license of $639,645 (80% of total assets) paid to Rain Cage Carbon under an LOI; after year end the company committed to a $4.9M note plus 27M shares (33.8% of the company) for a license, which raises valuation and recoverability risk

Share count does not reconcile: 46.7M outstanding at year end plus about 27.14M issued after year end comes to about 73.9M, but the cover reports 79.9M; inconsistent fee amounts in the LOI ($3-5M versus $4.9M); many typos, blank figures and internal inconsistencies, which suggest weak financial reporting
